svg.title: Phase 2: 5-stage pipeline with data cache and branch predictor, by package
svg.text: Phase 2: 5-stage pipeline with data cache and branch predictor, by package
Grey = reused as is. Solid colour = changed. Dashed colour = new. Blue italic = control signals. Signal names follow interfaces.md (stage suffix F D E M W).
forward · load-use stall · flush · memory stall
in: Rs1D Rs2D · Rs1E Rs2E RdE MemReadE · RdM RdW
Data hazards: forward from MEM or WB into EX; a load followed by a use stalls one cycle. Control hazards: branches and jumps are decided in EX; wrong-path fetches are flushed.
Memory hazard: a cache miss raises MemBusyM and freezes IF, ID, EX and MEM until the line arrives. Diagram wrong or out of date? Open a "Diagram error / change request" issue.
